visual_review.method: Sequential agent review of all 12 sheets; corrected scenes re-rendered and reviewed. No independent critic.
limitations: Chromium only; no Safari or Firefox check.
Sheets reconstruct path paint and do not reproduce every SVG mask, clip or dash effect. Gallery screenshot and existing exact-player behavior checks are separate evidence.
Sparse deterministic frames do not replace real-time timing review on devices.
